newsitem.title: USA: GM preferred stock tender expires.
newsitem.headline: GM preferred stock tender expires.

text.p: General Motors Corp said Thursday it received over half of its outstanding Series D and G Preference Stocks in response to an exchange offer for newly created Trust Originated Preferred Securities (TOPrS) that expired as scheduled on Wednesday.
The offer was launched on June 3.

Based on a preliminary count, GM said 3,049,930 shares, or about 50.25 percent, each representing one-fourth of a share of GM Series D 7.92 percent Preference Stock, were exchanged for 8.67 percent TOPrS issued by General Motors Capital Trust D.

About 50.23 percent or 5,063,308 shares, each representing one-fourth of a share of GM Series G 9.12 percent Preference Stock, were exchanged for 9.87 percent TOPrS issued by General Motors Capital Trust G.
Merrill Lynch & Co, Smith Barney Inc, Morgan Stanley Dean Witter, PaineWebber Inc and Prudential Securities Inc were retained as dealer managers.
